crossRefs.note: You shall weave the tunic with fine linen. You shall make a turban of fine linen. You shall make a sash, the work of…

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
translations.bsb: and the sash of finely spun linen, embroidered with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as the LORD commanded Moses.
translations.asv: and the girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer; as Jehovah commanded Moses.
